name: account-display
description: Shows who is signed in – first and last name, email, plan (Pro, Max 20x, Team Premium …) – in one line, above the prompt or in the status line below it.

position.title: Position
position.description: top = a row above the prompt; bottom = the status line under the prompt.

firstName.title: Show first name
firstName.description: The first name of the account's owner.

lastName.title: Show last name
lastName.description: The last name of the account's owner.

plan.title: Show plan
plan.description: The full account type: Free, Pro, Max 5x, Max 20x, Team Standard, Team Premium, Enterprise …
